statement: Only a properly-formed 4-2-2 all-digit date prefix counts as an existing dated record for reuse purposes; a malformed prefix (e.g. a 2-digit year) MUST NOT be matched.
reason: '26-07-01-' has only 2 digits in the year position, not 4, so the digit-anchored glob `[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-` does not match it. The conformant result is a FRESH dated file for today; reusing the malformed-prefix file is non-conformant.
